opening.argument: The speaker presents KuCoin as an opportunity tied to substantial returns, claiming that every holder receives 50% of trading profits paid every 24 hours: “for every trade that's made on KuCoin every KuCoin holder gets a split of that profit and that split out actually equals to 50%.” He then recommends purchasing at least $100 of KuCoin and directs interested viewers to sign up through a linked destination: “I do have the link where you guys to sign up on KuCoin if you're interested.” This is a concrete token purchase and referral solicitation, rather than cryptocurrency reporting. The speaker also compares the opportunity favorably with BitConnectX and says he expects that project to pay more.
